title: The Stochastic Team Orienteering Problem
summary: This paper analyses the Stochastic Team Orienteering Problem (STOP), a stochastic variant of the Team Orienteering Problem (TOP). In the STOP, travel times are represented by random variables. The objective is to determine a set of routes that maximises the expected collected profit. We model the problem as a two-stage stochastic integer program and propose an exact solution method based on the Integer L-shaped method.
